description: This nested pie chart, or sunburst chart, illustrates the character distribution within RoleplayPref by comparing primary categories in an inner ring with their specific subcategories in an outer ring. The chart displays a total of 3 inner slices and 13 outer slices. The inner ring consists of "Virtual Characters" in solid light blue, which occupies the majority of the chart at approximately 60%; "Real Characters" in solid light green, representing roughly 25%; and "Custom Characters" in solid pink, making up the remaining 15%. The outer ring is divided into subcategories shaded in lighter, pastel tints of their corresponding primary category colors. The very light blue section includes five slices labeled "Comic Characters" (which is the largest subcategory), "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters." The very light green section is divided into seven smaller slices labeled "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers." The very light pink section consists of a single, unlabeled outer slice. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit percentage numbers; instead, text labels are positioned directly on or adjacent to their respective segments. The text for the inner categories is black, while the outer category labels are bolded and color-coded to match the hues of their sections. No slices are visually exploded or offset, and the outer segments are not arranged in a strict descending or ascending size order.
